description.value: K&M Pizza and Indian Cuisine — formerly Dream Pizza — is a fast-food restaurant in Abbotsford that fuses two kitchens under one roof: hand-tossed pizzas made from dough rested overnight and authentic Indian dishes ranging from butter chicken and palak paneer to tandoori plates and biryani. The unusually broad menu spans well over 100 items across meat and vegetarian categories, making it a solid calorie-replenishment stop for cyclists with varied dietary needs. Online ordering and delivery are available, and OSM records outdoor seating on site.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: bollard (4 spaces) at 13m; rack (3 spaces) at 68m; rack (3 spaces) at 87m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully functional and confirms the business is actively operating as a dual-concept fast-food restaurant offering online ordering and delivery. The contact page gives the address as '1990 McCallum Rd, Abbotsford, BC V2S 3M6' — the street number matches OSM but the city (Abbotsford vs. OSM community tag of Chilliwack) and postal code (V2S 3M6 vs. OSM's V2T 3M6) both differ; the GPS coordinates (49.039°N, 122.293°W) align with Abbotsford, not Chilliwack, so the website address is used. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM community tag lists Chilliwack, but website contact page and GPS coordinates both point to Abbotsford — OSM community tag appears incorrect.
OSM postal code V2T 3M6 conflicts with V2S 3M6 shown on website contact page; used website value as more likely current.
OSM old_name 'Dream Pizza' indicates a recent rebrand; no operational concerns, but confirms the listing name should remain K&M Pizza and Indian Cuisine.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, actively operating restaurant with online ordering and a broad menu; straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists seeking a substantial hot meal.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Online menu lists 16 Veg. Dishes, 12 Veg. Appetizers, and 9 Vegetarian Speciality Pizzas, with named items including Palak Paneer, Aloo Parontha, Tandoori Roti, and Saffron Rice
